findings.description: The shipped data preparation calls custom ssaggregate for the port and country balance datasets, but the command implementation is absent from the supplied package, so main.do cannot complete.
findings.evidence: logs/translated_pipeline.log ends at ssaggregate after the trade and short-run panels have been generated.
findings.suggested_fix: Provide the exact ssaggregate implementation required by the shipped do-file.

findings.description: Several Table IV and V coefficients and standard errors do not recur in the direct R translation of the shipped models.
findings.evidence: logs/tables_IV_V.log: Table IV columns 4, 5, and 7 and Table V columns 3–5 differ from printed values at reported precision; see results.
findings.suggested_fix: Investigate the source data/version and exact Stata estimation behavior after restoring the missing helper; do not change model or sample to force a match.

findings.description: The provided data/source names differ for export value and event indicators; the source also omits _gdp suffixes in temporary gravity variables.
findings.evidence: The translation aliases expr_ff to expr_f, event_og to event and post_london to post_lon, and uses generated var1_gdp/var2_gdp names in the corresponding aggregations.
findings.suggested_fix: Align package field names with the script and correct these naming inconsistencies in the shipped files.

findings.description: Table IV column 6 references post_country, absent from the supplied data and preparation script.
findings.evidence: logs/tables_IV_V.log records the Poisson column as not executable.
findings.suggested_fix: Supply the intended post_country variable or correct the shipped command to the intended generated variable.

limitations: Stata was unavailable; analysis commands were translated directly into R.
Data preparation translated and executed through the port/country balance blocks; exact ssaggregate source is missing, so these balance data and dependent outputs were not computed.
The core short-run Table IV-V regression commands were translated and run. Table IV Poisson column 6 was not executable because post_country is not supplied or generated.
Tables I-III and other article tables/figures were not recomputed. Claims recorded for Tables I-V include each table scalar, but claims outside these exhibits are not exhaustively enumerated.
The reported discrepancies are from the R translation; model/provider and R package differences can contribute, and this check makes no judgement about scientific validity.
